meeting.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meeting.voteItem: Deferral of the item before the committee
meeting.summary: The committee reviewed the Department of Environmental Management's budget, including a 9% sewer rate increase, and deferred the item.
meeting.recap: The department said a 9% sewer rate increase covers higher operating costs and capital projects.[[0:30:34]] A division chief said sewer rates may stay near 9% for a couple more years, then slowly go down.[[0:34:33]] The department said fees paid by the Army Corps covered the cost of hauling fire debris to the landfill.[[0:37:20]] The department said a wastewater plant is nearing its treatment limit because of the strength of the incoming wastewater.[[0:46:53]] A county official said the administration does not plan to fully fund the village association's project, since it is not a county facility.[[1:06:16]] The department said it supports both of a council member's proposed bills but worries about having enough staff time.[[1:15:06]] Bill 62 would move recycling from the EP&S division back to the solid waste division.[[1:16:00]] Members' budget proposals are due by 4:30 p.m. Saturday.[[1:18:37]] The committee deferred (postponed) the item.[[1:31:46]] A council public hearing on the 2027 budget is set for 6 p.m. this evening.[[1:32:02]]
decided: The committee deferred the item after the presiding chair asked for objections.
meeting.next: Staff will send the department a written question about which capital projects drive the sewer rate increase. Staff will give members a final budget priority survey report at the beginning of decisions week. Members were told to put their priorities in the template until the committee decides how many each member can have.
